what.label: Product Overview
what.title: What Is Moroccan Black Soap?
what.desc: Moroccan black soap is a soft, paste-like soap traditionally made with olive-based ingredients. Unlike regular solid soaps, it has a smooth and creamy texture that makes it easy to apply on the skin. It is commonly used before exfoliation in hammam rituals, especially with a Kessa glove.
what.desc2: Its natural appearance, deep color, and traditional origin make it attractive for brands that want to offer authentic Moroccan skincare products. Many beauty businesses use black soap as part of body care collections, spa treatments, hammam kits, exfoliating routines, and natural skincare lines.
